name: NCAIR LMS assistant benchmark v2
description: Realistic, manual-grounded questions (written by the project team from the NCAIR onboarding manual and the NCAIR knowledge base, not collected from live users). Each case lists the expected tool calls, facts a correct answer must contain (each fact is a list of acceptable alternatives), the expected links, and the gold source sections that must be retrievable.

schema.expected_calls: list of {tool,args}; [] means no tool (small talk). Arg values are checked for get_portal_link.page_id and get_onboarding_step.step; search args are not checked.
schema.acceptable_tool_sets: optional alternative sets of tool NAMES that also count as correct routing
schema.expected_facts: list of facts; each fact is a list of alternatives, any one present (case-insensitive) satisfies that fact
schema.gold_sources: section ids ('doc/section') of which at least one should appear in the retrieved results
schema.should_abstain: true when the documents do not answer the question
schema.translation_status: multilingual questions are drafts and should be checked by native speakers

cases.query: Where can I find the NCAIR LMS website?
cases.reference_answer: The NCAIR LMS is at https://lms.ncair.nitda.gov.ng.

cases.query: Please send me the sign in link
cases.reference_answer: Sign in at https://lms.ncair.nitda.gov.ng/intern/signin.

cases.query: I need the page to log in to my intern account
cases.reference_answer: Log in at https://lms.ncair.nitda.gov.ng/intern/signin.

cases.query: Link to my profile page please
cases.reference_answer: Your profile page is https://lms.ncair.nitda.gov.ng/intern/profile.

cases.query: Where do I see my courses after logging in? Give me the link.
cases.reference_answer: Open the Courses page: https://lms.ncair.nitda.gov.ng/intern/courses (menu > Courses).

cases.query: What is the website of NCAIR itself, not the LMS?
cases.reference_answer: The NCAIR website is https://ncair.nitda.gov.ng/.

cases.query: Where do I go to register for the program?
cases.reference_answer: Registration starts at the hall; the invitation email's Complete registration button opens a page on https://lms.ncair.nitda.gov.ng.

cases.query: I'm a returning intern, where do I log back in?
cases.reference_answer: Returning interns sign in at https://lms.ncair.nitda.gov.ng/intern/signin.

cases.query: Can I get the NCAIR contact page link?
cases.reference_answer: The NCAIR contact page is https://ncair.nitda.gov.ng/contact/.

cases.query: Open the portal for me
cases.reference_answer: The NCAIR LMS portal is https://lms.ncair.nitda.gov.ng.

cases.query: Walk me through every step of the registration
cases.reference_answer: Lists all 10 steps from staff registration through registering for both beginner courses.

cases.query: What do I do in step 4?
cases.reference_answer: Fill in the form: email is pre-filled, enter your 11-digit NIN, phone, program (SIWES or NYSC), gender and a password of 8+ characters with a letter and a number; NYSC interns also pick a CDS day.

cases.query: I'm filling the form and don't know what to put for Program
cases.reference_answer: Tap the Program box and choose SIWES or NYSC, whichever you are.

cases.query: What should I do after I create my account?
cases.reference_answer: You will see Welcome aboard; tap the green Go to Sign In button.

cases.query: I'm on my dashboard, where do I tap to open my courses?
cases.reference_answer: Tap the menu icon at the top-left, then tap Courses.

cases.query: How do I register for Product Design after Python Beginners?
cases.reference_answer: Scroll to the Product Design Beginners card and tap its green REGISTER button.

cases.query: I opened the invitation email, what do I tap next?
cases.reference_answer: Tap the green Complete registration button in the email.

cases.query: How do I sign in the first time after creating my account?
cases.reference_answer: Keep the Email tab selected, enter your email and password, and tap Sign In.

cases.query: What is the very first thing that happens when I get to the hall?
cases.reference_answer: Staff register you using your details, and an invitation email is then sent to you.

cases.query: Which email should I look for and what is the subject line?
expected_facts: Complete your NCAIR LMS internship registration
cases.reference_answer: Look for a message from NCAIR LMS titled Complete your NCAIR LMS internship registration.

cases.query: What must the password checklist show before I create my account?
cases.reference_answer: All green ticks: at least 8 characters, a number, a letter and matching confirmation.

cases.query: I'm stuck on step 9
cases.reference_answer: On the Python Beginners card tap the green REGISTER button; if it shows Locked, registration is not open (before the day or after 5 PM).

cases.query: If I pass all my tests but miss too many classes, do I still pass?
cases.reference_answer: No. At least 75% attendance is required; below that you must retake the cohort even if you passed everything else.

cases.query: How often do SIWES interns need to sign their logbook?
cases.reference_answer: Every two weeks at NCAIR Headquarters, in person.

cases.query: What courses do SIWES interns take in their first cohort?
cases.reference_answer: Python Beginners and Product Design (UI/UX) Beginners, at the same time.

cases.query: What are the password requirements?
cases.reference_answer: At least 8 characters with at least one number and one letter, and both password boxes must match.

cases.query: What file formats and size are allowed for ID uploads?
cases.reference_answer: PDF or PNG, under 2MB.

cases.query: I can't find the registration email anywhere, what should I do?
cases.reference_answer: Check Spam, Junk and Trash, move the email to your Inbox, wait a minute and refresh, and tell a staff member if it still does not show.

cases.query: Do returning interns have to go through onboarding again?
cases.reference_answer: No. Returning interns sign in with their existing email and password.

cases.query: What happens if I fail a course, can I retake it?
cases.reference_answer: Yes. Open Courses, find the failed course and tap Re-register.

cases.query: As an NYSC member, what does picking a CDS day do for me?
cases.reference_answer: Selecting a CDS day gives you an official excuse from classes on that day.

cases.query: Where is NCAIR physically located?
cases.reference_answer: Plot 790, Alimoh-Abu Street, behind VIO Yard, Wuye District, Abuja.

cases.query: What time does registration close?
cases.reference_answer: Registration closes at 5:00 PM on the registration day.

cases.query: How many times a week are classes held and how long is each session?
cases.reference_answer: Three times a week, roughly 2 to 3 hours per session depending on the cohort.

cases.query: What is the minimum attendance I need to pass?
cases.reference_answer: At least 75% attendance.

cases.query: What is the order of the courses? What comes after Python Advanced?
cases.reference_answer: Data Science Beginners comes next in the strict sequence.

cases.query: How do I unlock the next course?
cases.reference_answer: Pass both attendance (75%) and assessments; the next course then unlocks under My Learning > Courses.

cases.query: What should I bring on registration day?
cases.reference_answer: Acceptance letter, NIN, a smartphone with data, and a password you will remember.

cases.query: Where do new interns physically register?
cases.reference_answer: At the 50-Seater Hall, e-Government Building (PSIN), right after orientation.

cases.query: Why does the REGISTER button say Locked?
cases.reference_answer: Registration only opens on the day and closes at 5 PM. If it is the day, refresh or ask staff.

cases.query: Are the two beginner courses compulsory for NYSC members?
cases.reference_answer: No, both courses are optional for NYSC interns, but they may register for both at once.

cases.query: Do SIWES interns have to register for both courses at once?
cases.reference_answer: Yes. SIWES interns must register for Python Beginners and Product Design Beginners.

cases.query: My internet is very slow at the hall. What can I do?
cases.reference_answer: Make sure your data is on, move nearer a window, or ask staff about Wi-Fi.

cases.query: What does NCAIR stand for and which body is it under?
cases.reference_answer: National Centre for Artificial Intelligence and Robotics, a special purpose vehicle of NITDA.

cases.query: I forgot my password, what now?
cases.reference_answer: On the sign-in screen tap Forgot password?, or ask a staff member.

cases.query: How long does the onboarding take?
cases.reference_answer: You can finish your own setup in about 10 to 20 minutes.

cases.query: Is there a support phone line I can call for registration issues?
cases.reference_answer: No. There is no external registration support link or phone line; onboarding is done on-site with facilitators in the PSIN hall.

cases.query: What's the WiFi password at the NCAIR building?
cases.reference_answer: The documents do not give the Wi-Fi password; the manual only says to ask staff about Wi-Fi.

cases.query: Who founded NCAIR and in what year?
cases.reference_answer: Not covered in the documents.

cases.query: If my laptop breaks during the program, will NCAIR replace it?
cases.reference_answer: Not covered in the documents.

cases.query: How much is the monthly stipend for interns?
cases.reference_answer: Not covered in the documents.

cases.query: What is the dress code at NCAIR?
cases.reference_answer: Not covered in the documents.

cases.query: Will I get a certificate at the end of the internship?
cases.reference_answer: Not covered in the documents.

cases.query: Who teaches Python Advanced?
cases.reference_answer: Not covered in the documents.

cases.query: What is the weather in Abuja today?
cases.reference_answer: Off-topic; the assistant only covers NCAIR LMS onboarding.

cases.query: Write me a poem about robots
cases.reference_answer: Off-topic; the assistant only covers NCAIR LMS onboarding.
